from pyspark.sql.functions import col, when, trim, current_timestamp, year, month
path_bronze_wh = 'abfss://telemetria@stlogitrackdevbrazsouth.dfs.core.windows.net/warehouse/2. BRONZE'
path_silver_wh = 'abfss://telemetria@stlogitrackdevbrazsouth.dfs.core.windows.net/warehouse/3. SILVER'
path_checkpoint = "abfss://telemetria@stlogitrackdevbrazsouth.dfs.core.windows.net/warehouse/_checkpoints/silver_warehouse"

# Ler a tabela na camada bronze
df_bronze_wh = (
    spark.readStream
                .format("delta")
                .load(path_bronze_wh)
                )

# Tratamento, Deduplicação e Regras de Negócio (Bronze -> Silver)
df_silver_wh =(

    df_bronze_wh
    .drop("arquivo_origem")
    .drop("data_ingestao")
    .withColumn("dt_processamento_silver", current_timestamp())
    .filter(col("warehouse_id").isNotNull())
    .withWatermark("timestamp","2 hours")
    .dropDuplicates(["warehouse_id","timestamp"])
    .withColumn("ano", year(col("timestamp")))
    .withColumn("mes", month(col("timestamp")))
    .withColumnRenamed("temperature","temperatura_celsius")
    .withColumnRenamed("humidity","umidade")
    # Flag de Alerta de Temperatura
    .withColumn(
        "status_temperatura",
        when(col("temperatura_celsius")> 28.0, "2")
        .when(col("temperatura_celsius")< 15.0, "3")
        .otherwise("1")
    )
    # Flag de Alerta de Umidade
   .withColumn(
     "status_umidade",
      when(col("umidade") > 63.0, "2")
      .when(col("umidade") < 30.0, "3")
      .otherwise("1")
    )
     # Status Geral do Armazém (Consolidado)
    .withColumn(
        "status_geral_armazem",
        when((col("temperatura_celsius") > 28.0) & (col("umidade") > 63.0 ), "2")
        .when((col("temperatura_celsius") < 15.0) & (col("umidade") < 30.0 ), "2")
        .otherwise("1")
        )

    

)
# Tabela transformada enviada para silver
spark.sql("CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS silver")
query = (
    df_silver_wh.writeStream
    .format("delta")
    .outputMode("append")
    .option("checkpointLocation", path_checkpoint)
    .option("path", path_silver_wh)
    .option("mergeSchema", "true")
    .partitionBy("ano","mes")
    .trigger(availableNow=True)
    .toTable("silver.tb_wh")
)
query.awaitTermination()
